title: Buggy on IOS
body: Can you please get it to work on iPhone? It’s been months I try to use this app and it just doesn’t work on an iPhone 13 Pro, I reported a bug months ago too and it never got fixed. I give this two stars because at least the sounds and idea of this app are good but it’s just disappointing that they charge so much and don’t even bother to make it work properly
author: yayi_io

title: Great job to the developers.
body: I really like the app and it’s very helpful to zone out and relax. The only negative thing I have to say is that it’s just too expensive, especially for the average person in Europe. So sadly I’ll have to cancel and stick with my current YouTube playlist.
author: Portugal Mick

title: Brilliant
body: Works, pleasant to use, amazing customer support - absolutely love brain.fm! Been my buddy for years already ❤️
author: zvitez

title: Got scammed
body: Paid for a monthly subscription but I didn’t receive the membership in app. When I click to upgrade it says I am already subscribed... The money was charged by Apple. I contacted their customer support but it is really bad, first they said I did not have an account and I said I did, then they found out I actually did... but they still argued I was not subscribed...
author: ReDevilgr

title: Realmente eficaz
body: Ajuda nos imenso lá em casa. Trabalhamos e passamos muitas horas com os miúdos pequenos. Esta aplicação é o som ambiente rotineiro e ajuda-nos a criar o ambiente que queremos proporcionar. Adoro
author: Francmartom
